name: ei-resource-compiler
description: EI Resource compiler, only currently used for new ProtoBuf decoder compilation.

scripts.compile: pbjs -t static-module -w closure --es6 --keep-case --no-create --no-encode --no-verify --no-beautify --no-comments --no-service --no-delimited -l \"\" -p ../../ProtobufModels ../../ProtobufModels/EXTHealingStats.proto | replace --search="export const GW2EIBuilders = " --newval="" | babel --no-babelrc --plugins=./babel-strip-proto-decoder.js | uglifyjs -m -c > ../logData.proto.min.js
